reviewMode: Keyboard-only Chromium journeys operated through Playwright and X11 key input, with full-size visual inspection of native-zoom focus output.

journeys.result: Skip link reaches main; the paired action remains focused after activation; all five bounded outcomes expose one current progress step; 320 reflow has no clipped focus or target.
Mission row opens Session Detail with main focus; Back restores the exact source row; direct and retained desktop detail use the documented main fallback without body focus.
Composer and four-command dock remain in source order; approval opens its labelled confirmation, cycles in both directions, dismisses with Escape, and restores the trigger.

journeys.keys: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Arrow keys, Escape
journeys.result: Model, goal, and Plan expose native groups and choices; focus stays inside each modal, scroll owners are keyboard reachable, confirmations receive sensible initial focus, and closure restores the connected command.
More, Usage, Compact, and Skills remain one nested-view chain; read-only overflow owners and search are reachable; Compact confirmation focus is explicit; Escape restores More.
Event details, interrupt, archive, laptop resume, and nested Host and access retain exact target/consequence text, modal containment, confirmation focus, and trigger restoration.
The Host and access body is keyboard scrollable even when empty; lock and revoke confirmations cycle and restore focus; recovery, compatibility, lock, and device controls remain in logical order.
Not-found recovery has one page heading and labelled link; activation returns to Mission Control and moves focus to main.

journeys.result: A 640x800 physical Chrome window becomes a 320x400 CSS layout at DPR 2; Mission, detail, and model remain one-column, horizontally contained, visibly focused, keyboard reachable, and correctly restored.
